original_ai_output.title_zh: 毛里求斯爆发数十年来最严重骚乱，一名女子遭警察枪击
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 毛里求斯因水资源短缺和高生活成本引发的抗议活动升级为数十年来最严重的骚乱，一名女子在路障处被警察开枪打伤。总理纳文·拉姆古兰下令实施宵禁，涉事警察已被逮捕羁押。尽管宵禁期间仍有零星事件和逮捕发生，警方表示周三上午交通已恢复。

key_facts.fact: 毛里求斯因水资源短缺和高生活成本爆发抗议并升级为骚乱
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Peaceful protests over water shortages and the high cost of living that started a week ago erupted into violence on Friday

key_facts.fact: 一名女子在路障处被警察开枪打伤，涉事警察已被逮捕羁押
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a woman was shot and wounded by police at a roadblock. The circumstances of the shooting are not clear, but the officer has since been arrested and remanded in custody

key_facts.fact: 总理纳文·拉姆古兰下令实施宵禁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Prime Minister Navin Ramgoolam ordered the curfew on Tuesday

key_facts.fact: 抗议者焚烧轮胎、封锁道路，警察局等公共设施遭到破坏
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Protesters burned tyres and blocked ‌roads as the unrest escalated over the weekend, with police stations and other public infrastructure properties being vandalised

key_facts.fact: 宵禁期间仍发生数起事件和逮捕，但周三上午交通已恢复
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Despite the curfew, police said there had been several incidents overnight and some arrests. But the police assured people that by Wednesday morning traffic was again moving throughout the island

uncertainties: 枪击事件的具体情况尚不清楚
